evaluations.name: repository-native dependency update
evaluations.query: Update a dependency in this multi-module Go repository. Its AGENTS.md says go.mod and go.work are generated and Make targets are authoritative.
expected_behavior: Reads repository guidance, workspace files, generation policy, and the relevant Make recipes before editing
Separates the module go directive, preferred toolchain, and CI version
Uses the repository update and verification targets rather than generic go mod tidy or go work sync
Reviews generated, dependency-graph, vendor, and compatibility effects without unrelated upgrades

evaluations.name: cancellation leak regression
evaluations.query: Fix a Go HTTP client method that leaks a goroutine when its context is canceled while a result send is blocked.
expected_behavior: Explains goroutine ownership, exit paths, channel ownership, cancellation observation, and the required happens-before edges
Adds or identifies a focused regression test that fails for the leak before changing the implementation
Uses testing/synctest only if the selected Go version supports the needed API and otherwise follows repository conventions
Runs focused tests and an applicable race lane, then reports what those checks do and do not prove

evaluations.name: resource ownership API review
evaluations.query: Review a Go library change that wraps a foreign file descriptor, exposes a byte slice view, and adds Close support.
expected_behavior: Determines whether descriptor ownership transfers and who may close it
Documents byte-slice aliasing, retention, mutation, concurrent access, and lifetime
Checks error identity, repeated Close behavior, finalization or cleanup assumptions, and platform-specific ABI constraints
Requests or runs target-specific invalid-input and allocation/free lifecycle tests

evaluations.name: measured iterator optimization
evaluations.query: Optimize allocations in a hot Go iterator without changing its public behavior.
expected_behavior: Defines the representative workload and compatibility invariants before optimizing
Captures repeated before and after benchmarks under the same toolchain, target, and flags
Uses benchstat and profiles or allocation evidence rather than a single benchmark number
Runs correctness gates and reports sample counts, variance, and remaining uncertainty

evaluations.name: non-Go styling request
evaluations.query: Adjust the responsive Tailwind classes in this TypeScript component without changing application behavior.
expected_behavior: Does not select the Go skill merely because the repository may contain unrelated Go code
